names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 30 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Ιωάννης ο εν τω φρέατι», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the calendar’s name link for 29 марта ст. ст., which gives «Иоанн Египетский, пустынник»; the rank word is not part of the stored form. The day’s own line prints «Прп. Иоанна пустынника» with no country.

feast.note: The Greek day is 30 Μαρτίου and this one is 29 марта, one day apart and not thirteen, so the difference is not the style conversion. The two were read as one man on the dry well and not on the day: see the note below.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 марта ст. ст. — «Прп. Иоанна пустынника (IV).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ής Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Ιωάννης ο εν τω φρέατι»

attestations.note: The page puts him in the years of the Church's persecutions by the idolaters and gives no year at all, so this folder carries no `dates`. It explains the epithet — the cave he had was too small, so the hermit was driven to use a dry well as his cell — and gives no country, no monastery, no relic and no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru’s life: «До самой своей блаженной кончины, последовавшей в IV веке, святой Иоанн жил в колодце». The day line prints «(IV)». This folder held no `dates`: saint.gr gives no year for anything in his life. No year of birth is stated by either page and none is inferred.
